svg.title: Seven experiments as a validity chain, with the arrow that sent the work back upstream
svg.desc: A dependency graph of seven experiments. Experiment 0 selects the search strategy; Experiment 1 justifies the array sizes; Experiment 2 checks convergence; Experiment 3 is the main comparison; Experiments 4, 5 and 6 test scaling, ablation and transfer. A dashed arrow from Experiment 3 back to Experiment 0 marks the redesign that the main comparison forced.

g.text: does it hold as L grows?
Experiment 3 finds the action space too coarse
Each experiment validates a precondition of the next; a problem found downstream sends the work back upstream instead of being reported unexamined.

svg.text: Source: dissertation Table 3.2 and §4.1.6 · each experiment is documented in experiments/expN_*/expN_stats.md
